content.value: The volume of a room is 600 m³. The wall area of the room is 220 m², the floor area is 120 $m ^ { 2 }$ and the ceiling area is 120 $m ^ { 2 }$ The average sound absorption co-efficient, (i) for the wall is 0.03; (ii) for the ceiling is 0.80, and (iii) for the floor is 0.06:
Calculate the average sound absorption co-efficient and the reverberation time.
